drag_text: Drag and drop an image here
drag_subtext: or open one with the button below
start_subtext: Take a photo of the flock or choose one from your gallery
viewer_settings_move: Drag to move, double-tap to put back
crop_hint: Drag the corners or edges to crop, or drag inside the frame to move it.
mask_hint: Paint over the parts of the photo that should not be counted.
history_clear_confirm: Remove all entries from the history? Photos taken in the app are deleted too.
share_missing: The original photo is no longer available.
history_delete_owned_confirm: Delete this entry and the photo taken in the app?
history_missing: The original photo is no longer available. Remove it from the history?
history_unlinked_detail: This photo was opened without a lasting location, so only its result was kept.
error_camera_unavailable: The camera is not available on this device.
error_camera_denied: Allow camera access for Birds Counter in Settings.
error_photos_denied: Allow access to your photos in Settings to open photos from the history.
error_photo_unreadable: The photo could not be read.
tip_min_radius: The smallest spot that counts as a bird (its radius in pixels). Raise it to skip specks, insects and noise.
tip_max_radius: The largest spot that is counted. Lower it to skip big dark shapes that aren't birds.
tip_threshold_method: How birds are told apart from the sky. Sky background compares each pixel with the sky around it and works best; Adaptive and Otsu are simpler methods for a plain, even sky.
tip_blur: Smooths the photo a little first, so single noisy pixels don't count. More blur loses faint birds and can join close ones.
tip_adaptive_block: The size of the area around each pixel that the sky is measured in. It should be wider than a bird; it grows with the photo.
tip_adaptive_c: How much darker than its surroundings a pixel must be to count. Raise it to ignore faint shapes.
tip_sensitivity: How much a bird must stand out from the sky's own texture, such as clouds. Lower it to find fainter birds, raise it to avoid false ones.
tip_morph_kernel: The size of the shape the opening and closing below work with.
tip_morph_open_iter: Removes small specks and thin lines. More passes remove more, and can erase small birds.
tip_morph_close_iter: Fills small holes and gaps inside birds. More passes can join close birds into one.
tip_sky_only: Counts only in the sky and ignores trees, buildings, land and water.
tip_split_clusters: Counts a spot larger than a single bird as several birds, for flocks where birds overlap.
tip_auto_invert: Picks on its own whether the dark or the light parts are birds: whichever covers less of the photo.
tip_invert: For light birds on a darker background, such as gulls against a dark sky or water.
